metadata.description: First-party plugins for SolidWorks Agent. Ships with the add-in (builtin-plugins) and is trusted.

plugins.name: agent-bridge
plugins.description: Connects the agent in SolidWorks to agent-bridge: message other AI agents (Claude Code, Codex, other SolidWorks Agent seats) and the operator's console, listen for work, and share projects (docs, tasks, data, files). Needs Node.js 18 or newer. Remote approvals from the console are not supported in SolidWorks Agent: approvals stay in the panel.

plugins.name: agent-bridge-solidworks
plugins.description: Agent Bridge inside SolidWorks: how the SolidWorks Agent handles bridge messages safely (the user's model and data stay under the user's control), and a /bridge command for peers, inbox, listening and the bridge name. Installed with Agent Bridge.

plugins.name: claude-mcp
plugins.description: Lets Claude Desktop on this PC talk to SolidWorks Agent: send the agent in SolidWorks a message and get its reply, and read the open model. Changes still need your OK in the SolidWorks Agent panel. Adds an MCP server named "solidworks-agent" to Claude Desktop's settings. Works on this PC only; no agent-bridge needed.

plugins.name: codex-mcp
plugins.description: Lets Codex on this PC (the app, CLI and IDE extension) talk to SolidWorks Agent: send the agent in SolidWorks a message and get its reply, and read the open model. Changes still need your OK in the SolidWorks Agent panel. Adds an MCP server named "solidworks-agent" to Codex's config.toml. Works on this PC only; no agent-bridge needed.
